notes.zh: AI 助手可以通过 MCP 直接在开着的 Crystery 里写插件、安装并试运行；MCP 默认开启；所有插件的按钮都放在“插件”标签里，装好插件后自动切过去。
notes.en: AI assistants can write, install and try out plugins in the open Crystery over MCP; MCP is on by default; every plugin's buttons are in the Plugins tab, which opens once a plugin is installed.

slots.zh: 现在支持插件创作，可以自行通过插件设计想要的功能。
slots.en: Crystery now supports plugins: build the features you want yourself.
